title: Cast All Your Cares on Him
story:
A young boy was worried about his father, who had to travel far away for several days.

Every evening, the boy would look at the door and wonder when his father would return.

He kept thinking about all the things that could go wrong, and his worry made it difficult for him to sleep.

One night, his mother sat beside him and reminded him that his father was in God's hands.

She told him, "You do not have to carry this worry alone. You can give it to God and trust Him to take care of what you cannot control."

The boy closed his eyes and prayed, telling God everything that was troubling his heart.

As he prayed, he began to feel peaceful.

The situation had not changed, but his heart had changed because he had placed his worries in God's hands.

We often carry worries about our family, work, health, future, relationships, and many things we cannot control.

God does not ask us to carry these burdens alone.

He invites us to give our worries to Him because He cares deeply for us.

Casting our cares on God does not mean that our problems will disappear immediately.

It means that we choose to trust Him instead of allowing fear and worry to control our hearts.

When we place our burdens in His hands, we can experience His peace and remember that we are never alone.

Whatever you are carrying today, you can bring it to God because He cares for you.
life_lesson: You do not have to carry your worries alone. Give every burden to God through prayer and trust Him, because He cares deeply about you and your situation.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for caring for me and for knowing everything that is happening in my life.

Help me to give all my worries and burdens to You instead of carrying them alone.

When I feel afraid or anxious about the future, remind me that You are with me and that I can trust You.

Give me peace when my mind is troubled and strength when my heart feels heavy.

Help me to trust Your plans even when I cannot see what is ahead.

Thank You for loving me and caring for me every day.

I place all my worries into Your hands today.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What worry or burden are you carrying today that you need to give to God?

Are you trying to handle something on your own instead of trusting God with it?

How can you remind yourself today that God cares deeply for you?
verse: Cast all your anxiety on Him because He cares for you.
